product_name: 便携式无人机察打一体设备2
summary: 便携式无人机察打一体设备集侦测、跟踪、定位、反制、联网功能于一体，单设备即可实现无人机管控全流程工作；系统续航充足、重量轻、加固设计，非常适合背负/手持。 设备通过无线电频率扫描无人机频谱特征、报文协议解析，侦测非法入侵的无人机，能够识别无人机与遥控器之间的控制信号、图传信号；并通过电磁压制技术，实现对无人机遥控链路、图传链路和导航信号的干扰阻断，迫使无人机返航或降落。
summary_en: The Integrated Detection & Jamming C-UAS (Pro) integrates detection, tracking, positioning, neutralization, and networking functions into a single unit, enabling a comprehensive drone management workflow. The system features extended battery life, lightweight construction, and a ruggedized design, making it highly suitable for backpack or handheld operations. It detects unauthorized drones by scanning radio frequencies for spectral signatures and parsing protocols. By identifying control and video transmission links and using electromagnetic suppression, it blocks remote control and navigation signals, forcing drones to land or return.
key_application: 应用领域：设备通过无线电频率扫描无人机频谱特征、报文协议解析，侦测非法入侵的无人机，能够识别无人机与遥控器之间的控制信号、图传信号；并通过电磁压制技术，实现对无人机遥控链路、图传链路和导航信号的干扰阻断，迫使无人机返航或降落。；探测与打击一体化设计，高度集成，单台设备即可完成无人机的探测和打击。；探测机型全
key_application_en: All-in-one detection and neutralization system; high integration for single-operator drone control; 3km effective suppression range; supports identification for consumer, industrial, and non-standard drones; 360° omni-directional monitoring with directional search capability.
key_parameter_1: 最大有效干扰距离: ≥3km（通视条件）

parameters.侦测模式: 能够提供全向探测和定向测向两种模式
parameters.工作时间: 侦测待机时间≥4h  反制连续不间断工作时间≥30min
parameters.供电方式: 内置锂电池/外置适配器
parameters.联网方式: 能够接入统一的无人机平台

parameters_en.Detection Mode: Provides both omni-directional and directional modes

detail_html:
功能特点

  • 察打一体：探测与打击集成化，单人单机即可完成探测预警、识别定位与反制阻断。
  • 探测机型全：应对复杂电磁环境，支持消费、行业及非标改装机的识别，极低误报。
  • 打击距离远：典型目标（如Mavic 3）压制距离可达3km。
  • 无源搜寻：采用静默搜寻，360°探测全空域风险。
  • 精准识别：解析目标ID，获取序列号、航迹及飞手位置信息。
  • 多种模式：支持驱离、降落、悬停多种处置效果。
  • Figure 1 Integrated Detection & Jamming C-UAS (Pro)
detail_html_en:
Features

  • Integrated C-UAS solution: combines detection, warning, identification, and jamming into a single operator tool.
  • Comprehensive identification: filters through complex RF environments to identify consumer, professional, and custom-built drones with high accuracy.
  • Superior range: achieves up to 3km suppression range for typical targets in open air.
  • Passive monitoring: silent search mode provides 360° situational awareness without emitting telltale signals.
  • Data precision: extracts serial numbers, flight paths, and pilot locations via advanced protocol parsing.
  • Tactical flexibility: multiple jamming modes to force landing, return-to-home, or hovering.
